transactions_import_hash_unique.name: transactions_import_hash_unique
transactions_import_hash_unique.where: "transactions"."import_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."import_file_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."deleted_at" IS NULL

transactions_external_id_unique.name: transactions_external_id_unique
transactions_external_id_unique.where: "transactions"."external_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."deleted_at" IS NULL

transactions_amount_sign_check.name: transactions_amount_sign_check
transactions_amount_sign_check.value:
("transactions"."type"::text = 'income' AND "transactions"."amount_minor" > 0)
        OR ("transactions"."type"::text IN ('expense', 'transfer') AND "transactions"."amount_minor" < 0)
        OR ("transactions"."type"::text IN ('adjustment', 'opening_balance') AND "transactions"."amount_minor" <> 0)

transactions_transfer_account_check.name: transactions_transfer_account_check
transactions_transfer_account_check.value:
("transactions"."type"::text = 'transfer' AND "transactions"."transfer_account_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("transactions"."type"::text <> 'transfer' AND "transactions"."transfer_account_id" IS NULL)
